note: Fixed facts the controlled apps answer from. No network, no scraping.

entries.question: What time does the library open?
entries.answer: The library opens at 8am.
entries.context: The university library opens at 8am and closes at 10pm on weekdays.

entries.question: Where is the student health centre?
entries.answer: The student health centre is in Building C.
entries.context: The student health centre is located in Building C, next to the pharmacy.

entries.question: How do I reset my campus password?
entries.answer: Use the self-service portal at password.example.edu.
entries.context: Campus passwords are reset through the self-service portal at password.example.edu.

entries.question: When does the autumn semester start?
entries.answer: The autumn semester starts on 2 September.
entries.context: Teaching for the autumn semester starts on 2 September and ends on 20 December.

entries.question: What is the deadline for tuition payment?
entries.answer: Tuition is due on 15 August.
entries.context: Tuition fees must be paid by 15 August for the autumn semester.

entries.question: How many books can I borrow at once?
entries.answer: You can borrow up to ten books.
entries.context: Students may borrow up to ten books at a time for three weeks.

entries.question: Who do I contact about a broken laptop?
entries.answer: Contact the IT service desk in Building A.
entries.context: Hardware problems are handled by the IT service desk in Building A.

entries.question: Is there a shuttle between campuses?
entries.answer: Yes, the shuttle runs every 20 minutes.
entries.context: A free shuttle bus connects the two campuses every 20 minutes from 7am to 9pm.

entries.question: What is the maximum class size?
entries.answer: Seminars are capped at 24 students.
entries.context: Seminars are capped at 24 students; lectures have no cap.

entries.question: How do I apply for a scholarship?
entries.answer: Apply through the scholarships office by 30 April.
entries.context: Scholarship applications go to the scholarships office and close on 30 April.

entries.question: Where can I print my assignments?
entries.answer: Printers are on the ground floor of the library.
entries.context: Student printers are on the ground floor of the library and in Building B.

entries.question: Does the cafeteria serve vegetarian food?
entries.answer: Yes, the cafeteria has a vegetarian counter.
entries.context: The main cafeteria has a vegetarian counter open from 11am to 3pm.

entries.question: What is the exam resit policy?
entries.answer: One resit is allowed per module.
entries.context: Students may resit a failed module once, in the resit period in August.

entries.question: How do I join the gym?
entries.answer: Sign up at the sports centre reception.
entries.context: Gym membership is arranged at the sports centre reception; student rate is 15 per month.

entries.question: Which email address does the registrar use?
entries.answer: The registrar writes from registrar@example.edu.
entries.context: Official letters come from the registrar at registrar@example.edu.

entries.question: What are the library weekend hours?
entries.answer: The library is open 10am to 6pm at weekends.
entries.context: At weekends the library opens at 10am and closes at 6pm.

entries.question: How do I appeal a grade?
entries.answer: Submit a grade appeal within 14 days.
entries.context: Grade appeals must be submitted to the examinations office within 14 days.

entries.question: Is there childcare on campus?
entries.answer: A campus nursery takes children from age two.
entries.context: The campus nursery accepts children from age two and is open 7:30am to 6pm.

entries.question: How do I get a student ID card?
entries.answer: Collect your ID card from the library desk.
entries.context: Student ID cards are printed at the library desk during the first two weeks.

entries.question: What is the counselling appointment wait?
entries.answer: Counselling appointments are usually within five working days.
entries.context: Counselling requests are triaged within 24 hours; routine appointments are offered within five working days.
